e_braise_tenace:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: perspective VFX approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric turn based tactical game. This is a NEW drawn proposal, not a screenshot or a finished game asset. Landscape high resolution editorial concept sheet on warm pale parchment. Crisp ink contours, hard edged cel animation shapes, 2 to 3 flat shadow values, carefully controlled saturated accents, no blurry light bloom, no smoke particles filling the page, no photorealism. Viewpoint high three quarter orthographic, square stone grid tiles projected as diamonds, readable grey stylized articulated mannequin for scale with simple Greco-fantasy silhouette. Show top, side faces and overlap in perspective. Three equal large storyboard panels across the top and a shallow supporting strip below, generous negative space. One dominant readable action per panel. Clean elegant French labels, only the quoted text. Each panel repeats the same camera and scale. These drawings must be reproducible with a few simple faceted Blender meshes and short cel sprite animations.
Title "E — Braise tenace". Subtitle "THAUMATURGE · IMPACT + BRÛLURE".
Panel 1 caption "01 · Compression": a small dense ember lozenge the size of a fist, charcoal red shell with hot cream core and only two orange flame tongues, flies toward a grey enemy from the left. It reads as one short compact projectile.
Panel 2 "02 · Éclatement": single compact angular explosion at enemy upper torso, five chunky flame wedges curling outward around a tiny white core, maximum half the target's height, face and legs visible, no ground fire, no second hit.
Panel 3 "03 · Braise active": same intact target, NO surrounding fiery aura. A single tiny asymmetric coal shard with two warm cracks hovers just outside the right hip, attached to the unit rather than the ground. One small inset next to it shows this same ember briefly opening two flame tips during a periodic damage pulse; do not show multiple coals around the unit.
Bottom strip: enlarged sculptural ember design, four swatches coal dark plum / brick red / vermilion / pale cream. Separate clearly boxed small alternate-material study: one water tile under grey ankles transforming into a compact pale grey cel steam plume; label "Sur eau dynamique : vapeur". It must be visually separated from the main burn story so the steam is conditional.
Footer "Deux pulsations aux activations de la cible". No numbers claiming seconds or damage. No gore, no permanent inferno, no extra enemies. Show bold compact satisfying contact and extremely restrained persistence.

Title "F — Contre préparé". Subtitle "GARDIEN · GARDE + RIPOSTE".
Panel 1 "01 · Armement": a thick angular bronze crescent buckler folds together beside the grey hero's forearm, dark brown back, ochre bronze facets, bright ivory upper rim. Two overlapping blades join with a decisive little sparkle; no explosion on enemy, no fortress, no full sphere.
Panel 2 "02 · En attente": same hero in same place. A SINGLE smaller bronze wedge token beside the hip announces the armed counter; a tiny separate shield badge at foot level indicates remaining guard. The silhouette of the character is clear and no giant barrier hides him. A grey enemy with muted rust sash is adjacent but has not yet hit.
Panel 3 "03 · Riposte": adjacent rust-sash enemy's weapon makes contact at hero side, then the bronze crescent snaps forward in ONE short directional ivory-edged slash into that same enemy's chest, compact white impact star. Draw one readable counter stroke only, no radial shockwave, no projectile toward distant enemies. Hero and enemy stay on their original adjacent squares.
Bottom strip: larger faceted crescent model shown front and back, four swatches umber / bronze / honey / ivory. One small endpoint drawing of hero with the counter token now GONE and only the small guard badge still present. Label "Riposte consommée · garde restante". Footer "Une riposte au contact · attente jusqu’au prochain tour". Keep guard and armed counter visibly distinct. No false healing, no permanent invulnerability.
g_permutation:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: perspective VFX approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric turn based tactical game. This is a NEW drawn proposal, not a screenshot or a finished game asset. Crisp ink contours, hard edged cel animation shapes, 2 to 3 flat shadow values, carefully controlled saturated accents, no blurry light bloom, no smoke particles filling the page, no photorealism. Viewpoint high three quarter orthographic, square stone grid tiles projected as diamonds, readable grey stylized articulated mannequin for scale with simple Greco-fantasy silhouette. Show top, side faces and overlap in perspective. Three equal large storyboard panels across the top and a shallow supporting strip below, generous negative space. One dominant readable action per panel. Clean elegant French labels, only the quoted text. Each panel repeats the same camera and scale. These drawings must be reproducible with a few simple faceted Blender meshes and short cel sprite animations.
Title "G — Permutation". Subtitle "ARPENTEUR · ÉCHANGE DE POSITIONS".
Exactly TWO characters per storyboard panel: hero with muted jade short cloak and bronze shoulder, enemy grey mannequin with muted rust sash. They occupy two specific nonadjacent grid squares, three squares apart along the same diagonal world grid axis. Always repeat the identical grid, camera and tile locations, and never create a third body or ghost clone.
Panel 1 "01 · Deux ancrages": hero in foreground-left square, enemy in background-right square. One low split oval clasp forms immediately around EACH pair of ankles, no floor puddle. Each clasp consists of two opposed jade and pale ivory curved blades, a little bronze tab. Clearly two endpoints, no connecting line.
Panel 2 "02 · Bascule": the two clasps close into slim vertical page-shaped slits on those exact two squares while the two bodies flatten briefly into their own silhouettes. This is a simultaneous teleport, NOT a run, no continuous travel trail, no arrow crossing the intermediate squares, no path, no damage burst.
Panel 3 "03 · Positions échangées": rust-sash enemy now in foreground-left square and jade-cloak hero now in background-right square. The exact same two characters have exchanged places. Clasps split into two tiny chips and vanish at each endpoint. Both characters intact, upright, no injury.
Bottom strip: enlarged two-piece clasp design and four flat swatches deep teal / jade / warm bronze / ivory. Footer "Deux positions · aucun dégât · aucune porte persistante". Maintain easily auditable position continuity. No sci-fi circles with runes, no huge portals, no starfield, no boss monster.

Title "H — Orage du passage". Subtitle "LÉGENDAIRE · FRAPPE DE ZONE".
Main layout three large panels, same isometric battlefield viewpoint. Hero center with muted jade cloak; exactly three grey enemies with muted rust details at different nearby tiles. The spell is SELF centered, instant and enemy-only. All three enemy positions are within Manhattan distance two of hero; do not draw enemies outside the range. No companion.
Panel 1 "01 · Charge": one low broken navy-and-cyan crown of angular electric segments compresses around hero at ankle-to-knee height, hero face visible. Strong silhouette, controlled negative space, modest cream sparks. No damage hits yet.
Panel 2 "02 · Frappe groupée": one thick graphic lightning blade drops onto EACH of the three enemies at the SAME instant, each bolt cream core with turquoise side and deep navy edge. Three bold vertical bolts with compact jagged ivory contact stars. They visually belong to one synchronized discharge, not three successive attacks. The hero stays intact and unstruck at center, legs and grid stay readable. Bolt tops taper into empty parchment above the enemies, no sky cloud, no gigantic screen-wide explosion, no continuous broad floor disc.
Panel 3 "03 · Retombée": same hero and three enemies standing, bolts have collapsed to a few thin navy and cyan fragments fading above their original contact locations; all ground clear, no rain, no electrified terrain, no persistent storm.
Bottom left exact small top-down range diagram: square 5 by 5 tiled grid, only cells whose Manhattan distance from center is 2 or less shaded, row lengths 1,3,5,3,1 making thirteen cells including center, central hero dot. Label "Rayon de 2 · cases autorisées". This diagram is a rule annotation, not a projected gameplay effect.
Bottom right enlarged lightning silhouette and four color swatches navy / teal / electric cyan / ivory. Footer "Une seule frappe par ennemi · aucune zone durable". Epic weight from clear anticipation and synchronized strikes, not particle clutter.
